purpose: Exact-family official-source replication of frozen Trial 2 using Binance public REST history because GitHub Actions billing currently prevents the checksum-archive primary evaluation. This replication cannot substitute for or rescue the primary archive protocol.

dataRequirements.paginationRule: request explicit startTime/endTime pages, retain raw response bytes and SHA-256 per page, deduplicate only exact duplicate timestamps, and require the final normalized scheduled grid to match the frozen window exactly

fundingTimestampNormalization.mappingRule: map raw fundingTime to the nearest 8-hour UTC boundary only when absolute raw-to-boundary skew is <=60,000 milliseconds
fundingTimestampNormalization.collisionRule: abort if two distinct raw funding observations map to the same scheduled boundary
fundingTimestampNormalization.priceRuleAfterMapping: use only exact 8h spot, standard perpetual-contract, and mark-price kline opens at that scheduled boundary; never interpolate or use a later price

rejectEvaluationIf: any REST page fails or cannot be hashed
a raw fundingTime is more than 60 seconds from its nearest scheduled 8-hour UTC boundary
two funding observations collide on one scheduled boundary
the final scheduled funding grid is not exactly 5,295 rows from 2021-05-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-28T16:00:00Z
spot, standard perpetual-contract, or mark-price open is missing at any scheduled boundary
any interpolation or forward-fill would be required

historicalRobustnessWindow.entryTimestampRule: use the first normalized scheduled funding boundary at or after startInclusive
historicalRobustnessWindow.exitTimestampRule: use the final normalized scheduled funding boundary strictly before endExclusive
historicalRobustnessWindow.fundingAfterEntry: accrue only realized funding payments on later normalized scheduled timestamps using contemporaneous mark notional

candidate.position: long BTC spot and short exactly equal BTC units of BTCUSDT perpetual
candidate.entryRule: enter once at the beginning of the frozen historical robustness window
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs at the end of the frozen historical robustness window
candidate.perpetualShortSizingRule: short exactly the BTC units purchased by the 15%-of-starting-equity spot leg
candidate.fundingAccounting: skip entry payment; later short receives positive funding and pays negative funding on BTC units times contemporaneous mark price times realized funding rate
candidate.basisAccounting: standard contract open is entry/exit execution reference; mark price is valuation/funding/margin reference

evaluation.historicalHoldoutIntegrity: Official REST replication evidence only, not pristine validation and not promotion eligible. Whole-sample funding summary statistics were already visible before Trial 2 and this replication were frozen.
evaluation.promotionRequires: never promote from this replication; the primary archive Trial 2 plus a later untouched forward or independently sealed evaluation remain required

antiRescueRule: No funding threshold, sign filter, leverage/allocation change, entry date selection, rebalancing, or data-gap fill may be introduced after observing this replication. Any changed economic candidate is a new numbered trial.
